item.title: Denialism Preserves Scientific Controversies: a Case Study of Abusive Head Trauma Research
item.description: The traditional theory of abusive head trauma requires scientific scrutiny. Those who question the validity of this theory have been accused of denialism for the purpose of obfuscating evidence in legal settings and supporting abusive caregivers. The tradi­tional theory holds that abusive head trauma results from “shaken baby syndrome”.
